purpose: Convert leak-safe L1.7 full-field horse diagnostics into calibrated finish-order probabilities, derive probabilities for all supported ticket types from one shared order model, then join market prices for valuation. Stake sizing and portfolio allocation belong to L3.

responsibility_boundary.l17: Horse diagnosis only. No odds, payout, ROI, result labels, Gate, Outsider, or ticket decisions.
responsibility_boundary.l2: Estimate finish-order and ticket-hit probabilities, join market prices after probability estimation, and emit ranked ticket candidates with valuation metadata.
responsibility_boundary.l3: Choose final portfolio, stake sizes, bankroll exposure, cross-ticket diversification, and race-level spend.

core_stages.description: Learn one race-normalized latent strength per horse from L1.7 full-field information and allowed pre-race context. Odds, popularity, payout, and post-race fields are forbidden model inputs.
Derive ticket-hit probabilities from the shared finish-order model instead of training unrelated hard-coded ticket templates.
Join timestamp-governed market prices only after probability prediction. Compute fair_odds, edge, and expected_return_index.
Emit all races and a reconstructable/full candidate ranking. Do not drop races because they fail a handcrafted rule. L3 decides bankroll allocation.

order_model_v1.reason: A single finish-order distribution can generate WIN, QUINELLA, EXACTA, TRIO, and TRIFECTA probabilities coherently without five separate rule systems.

probability_rules.quinella: P(i first, j second) + P(j first, i second)
probability_rules.trifecta: P(i first, j second, k third)
probability_rules.trio: sum of the six ordered top-three permutations for {i,j,k}

market_stage.historical_final_odds: Allowed only as historical valuation/evaluation proxy and must be labeled as such.

evaluation.promotion_rule: No production promotion from ROI alone. Probability calibration and stability across walk-forward years are mandatory.

dead_heat_policy.training: Must be tie-aware or explicitly isolate dead-heat races; input row order must never break ties.
dead_heat_policy.ticket_evaluation: Official winning ticket/payout records are the source of truth for hit evaluation.

legacy_status.rule: Legacy findings may be compared against L2_CORE_V1 but are not part of the core definition unless later revalidated as features or policies.
